\section{Why the rank-only diagnosis is incomplete}

This strengthens, without replacing, the preceding
\texttt{VARIABLE\_POLAR\_NOISE\_NORMALIZATION\_CHALLENGE.tex}, SHA256
\begin{center}\scriptsize\texttt{6f2827927204776cc7f36846a06293382801c7aa69815fa775914cdec81ab04b}.\end{center}
That source proves a coNP-complete global law certificate and an exponential
same-order width separation for a two-valued rank invariant.  The stronger
construction below has \emph{constant full polar rank}, a fixed diagonal-one
pivot schedule and an explicit cheap polar congruence.  The hard information
survives solely in the quadratic phase.  Consequently neither varying rank nor
branching among pivot schedules is the essential general obstruction.

The preceding source retains the exact prior-art qualifications and ordinary
raw input accounting.  The fixed-polar producer is unchanged.

\section{An explicit triangular source whose phase is an arbitrary CNF truth value}

Let $F(x)$ be any CNF formula on $n$ actual state bits, and let $z$ be an
additional actual state bit.  Use the explicit directed acyclic path-sum
construction in the preceding proof to obtain a strictly upper triangular
matrix $N(x,z)$ with affine state entries and
\[
 \big((I+N)^{-1}\big)_{s,t}=zF(x).
\]
Write $A=I+N$, of size $m$, and $h=zF(x)$.  All diagonal entries of $A$ are
literally one.  Its rank is $m$ at every state and its triangular solves need
no data-dependent pivot branch.

Take $2m$ actual fresh uniform noise bits $u,v$ and define the scalar channel
\[
 G(x,z,u,v)=u^TA(x,z)v+u_t+v_s.\tag{1}
\]
This is a sparse cubic Boolean function with state degree at most one and noise
degree at most two.  Let
\[
 a=A^{-1}e_t,\qquad r=A^Tu+e_s,\qquad w=v+a.
\]
The change $(u,v)\mapsto(r,w)$ is affine and invertible at every actual state,
and direct expansion gives
\[
 r^Tw=u^TAv+u_t+v_s+e_s^TA^{-1}e_t=G+h.
\]
Thus
\[
 \boxed{\qquad G=r^Tw+h(x,z).\qquad}\tag{2}
\]
The polar matrix of (1) is
$\left(\begin{smallmatrix}0&A\\A^T&0\end{smallmatrix}\righ

statement: The acquired-source challenge has sparse cubic G=u^T A(x,z)v+u_t+v_s, A unit triangular, constant full polar rank, fixed unit pivots and cheap congruence. Its exact P(G=0|x,z)=1/2+(-1)^(zF(x))2^(-m-1). Exact global law independence is coNP-complete although the raw gate common-order widths are polynomial.
